name_note: The suffix _A marks a GTDB split of the classical genus Dorea; the genomes GTDB places in this species carry the NCBI name Dorea longicatena.

sentences.text: Dorea longicatena was described from two strains of a gram-positively staining, obligately anaerobic, non-spore-forming, rod-shaped bacterium isolated from human faeces.
The describing study proposed those strains as a species of a novel genus, Dorea longicatena, and transferred Eubacterium formicigenerans to the same genus as Dorea formicigenerans.
Analysis of the 16S rRNA gene sequences indicated that these strains were members of the Clostridium coccoides rRNA group of organisms.
A study that analysed gut microbiota of patients with Parkinson's disease by high throughput 16S rRNA sequencing reported reduced content of Dorea longicatena in those patients.
